sentences.text:
Shri Akhilesh Kumar Saxena - advocate for the petitione
 Shri Virendra Khadav appearing on behalf of Advocate Ge
 Order
Heard and perused the record.

This is first bail application filed under Section 483 of BNSS, 2023 (Section 439 of Cr.P.C, 1973) for grant of bail during trial relating to Crime No.141/2024 dated (not mentioned), registered at Police Station-Balwada District-Khargone for the offence under Sections 363, 366, 376, 376(2)(n), 506 of IPC and under Section 5(L)/6 of POCSO Act.
The applicant is in custody since 28.08.2024.
2. As per the prosecution story, the allegation against the applicant and co-accused is that of commission of rape upon the prosecutrix.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present crime.

It is further submitted that the allegations against the applicant is only helped the co-accused by giving his motorcycle on which the prosecutrix was taken by main accused and except that, there is noting on record against the applicant.
The applicant is having no criminal record.
The applicant is in custody since 8.08.2024.
Conclusion of trial will take sufficient long time.
Under these circumstances, counsel prays for grant of bail to the applicant.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-IND:31896 2 MCRC-48138-2024 4.
Learned counsel for the State has opposed the application and prayed for its rejection.

sentences.text: 5. I have heard the learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

6. Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, the rival submissions of the counsel for the parties, custody period of the applicant, without commenting on the merits of the case, this application is allowed.

7. It is directed that the applicant be released on bail on his/her furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety to the satisfaction of the trial court for securing his/her presence before the said Court on all the dates of hearing fixed in this regard during trial.

It is also directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 480(3) of BNSS.
8.

This order shall remain effective till the end of the trial, but in case of bail jump and breach of any of the pre-condition of bail, it shall become ineffective and cancelled without reference to this Bench.
